data.message: All 49 fellow fishers: will you commit to 18 tons each this month? I commit to 18. Versus 10 each, that's $8,000 extra per person ($400,000 total). With everyone at 18, 100 tons remain: next month stock is 1,000 with 75% probability or 200 with 25%. At 10 each, recovery to 1,000 is certain. So 18 pays more now but risks leaner future income; excess catches could also trigger collapse below 50 remaining. Please explicitly pledge 18 or voice concerns; future cooperation isn't enforced.
